items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I remember Rex Vic(?) telling me that that was done

ctx.x: Yeah, I think so. I don't know. I (?).
I remember Rex Vic(?) telling me that that was done...like recorded in nine hours or something, straight through!
Well, we recorded it damn well, I'll tell you that. Then we had to leave right after we recorded it. Going somewhere way down in France; I don't know. Or the ...(?)... Maybe we was going to Milan.
